message: PctWidget (libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts) extends `PctWidgetBase`, which the file imports from './base', where no class of the sources is declared `export class` under that name
$reason: `base.ts` declares `PctWidgetBase`, with the naming inputs, and `PctBareBase`, without them, and exports each under the other's name. `widget.ts` imports `PctWidgetBase`, so TypeScript binds it to `PctBareBase`, and the widget Angular builds has no name (measured through ngc in partial mode). Read as the class the module declares under that name, the base handed the widget both inputs, and the case passed. An export written as a clause is not followed, so the base is one point 1 refuses.
